items.d: A 100% virgin original ECU file is an unmodified factory binary readout extracted directly from an engine or transmission control unit (or downlo…
items.k: glossary definition 100% virgin original ecu file (.ori) a 100% virgin original ecu file is an unmodified factory binary readout extracted directly from an engine or transmission control unit (or downloaded via genuine oem virtual read) with all factory maps, diagnostic fault classes, torque monitors, and checksum blocks completely intact.

items.d: DAMOS and ASAP2 (.A2L) files are official OEM engineering description files created by ECU manufacturers (Bosch, Continental, Delphi, Denso, Mare…
items.k: glossary definition damos, asap2 (.a2l) & winols (.ols) map definitions damos and asap2 (.a2l) files are official oem engineering description files created by ecu manufacturers (bosch, continental, delphi, denso, marelli) that define exact hexadecimal memory addresses, data types, conversion factors, units, and axes for every calibration parameter inside a specific ecu software build.

items.d: Bench Service Mode (using General Purpose Timer signals GPT1 and GPT2 alongside CAN High/Low and switched +12V/24V power) is a non-invasive manuf…
items.k: glossary definition bench service mode (gpt1 / gpt2) ecu reading bench service mode (using general purpose timer signals gpt1 and gpt2 alongside can high/low and switched +12v/24v power) is a non-invasive manufacturer factory protocol that reads and writes full internal microcontroller flash and eeprom directly through the external ecu pins without opening the metal housing.

items.d: TPROT (Tuning Protection) is a cryptographic bootloader security layer introduced by Bosch on Tricore MEDC17 and SPC58/Aurix MD1/MG1 ECUs that ve…
items.k: glossary definition tprot (tuning protection) & rsa signature verification tprot (tuning protection) is a cryptographic bootloader security layer introduced by bosch on tricore medc17 and spc58/aurix md1/mg1 ecus that verifies rsa digital signatures before permitting calibration flashing over the vehicle obd-ii port.

items.d: A Calibration Verification Number (CVN) is a standardized OBD-II Mode $09 hexadecimal hash computed by the ECU across its active calibration memo…
items.k: glossary definition cvn (calibration verification number) & block checksums a calibration verification number (cvn) is a standardized obd-ii mode $09 hexadecimal hash computed by the ecu across its active calibration memory blocks so inspection stations and oem diagnostic tools can verify software integrity.

items.t: Virtual Read (VR) in Master ECU Programmers
items.d: A Virtual Read (VR) occurs when an ECU blocks direct OBD memory readout, so the hardware programmer reads the ECU Software Identification (SW/CAL…
items.k: glossary definition virtual read (vr) in master ecu programmers a virtual read (vr) occurs when an ecu blocks direct obd memory readout, so the hardware programmer reads the ecu software identification (sw/cal-id) over obd and downloads the matching 100% unmodified factory binary from the tool manufacturer’s cloud server.

items.t: SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction) & AdBlue / DEF Dosing
items.d: Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) is an active diesel aftertreatment subsystem that injects automotive-grade 32.5% urea solution (AdBlue / DEF)…
items.k: glossary definition scr (selective catalytic reduction) & adblue / def dosing selective catalytic reduction (scr) is an active diesel aftertreatment subsystem that injects automotive-grade 32.5% urea solution (adblue / def) upstream of a catalyst to convert nitrogen oxides (nox) into nitrogen and water vapor, monitored by upstream/downstream nox sensors and inducement counters.

items.t: AdBlue "No Start in XXX km" Inducement Lock
items.d: The AdBlue start-inducement counter is a legislative Euro 6 / Tier 4F state machine stored across ECU Flash and EEPROM/DCU memory that restricts …
items.k: glossary definition adblue "no start in xxx km" inducement lock the adblue start-inducement counter is a legislative euro 6 / tier 4f state machine stored across ecu flash and eeprom/dcu memory that restricts engine restarting once remaining range reaches 0 km due to reagent quality, heater, pump, or nox sensor faults.

items.t: DPF (Diesel Particulate Filter) Soot & Ash Mass Model
items.d: The Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF / FAP) soot and ash model is a mathematical simulation inside the diesel ECU combining differential exhaust pr…
items.k: glossary definition dpf (diesel particulate filter) soot & ash mass model the diesel particulate filter (dpf / fap) soot and ash model is a mathematical simulation inside the diesel ecu combining differential exhaust pressure (hpa), volumetric exhaust flow, and egt sensors to schedule post-injection active regenerations.

items.d: An Otto Particulate Filter (OPF / GPF) is a ceramic exhaust substrate fitted to Euro 6d direct-injection turbo-petrol engines (such as VAG TSI, B…
items.k: glossary definition opf / gpf (otto / gasoline particulate filter) an otto particulate filter (opf / gpf) is a ceramic exhaust substrate fitted to euro 6d direct-injection turbo-petrol engines (such as vag tsi, bmw b48/b58/s58, amg m177/m139, and audi rs tfsi) monitored via differential exhaust backpressure sensors.

items.d: High-Pressure EGR routes exhaust gas directly from the exhaust manifold into the intake manifold, whereas Euro 6 Low-Pressure EGR draws clean, co…
items.k: glossary definition high-pressure (hp-egr) vs low-pressure (lp-egr) loops high-pressure egr routes exhaust gas directly from the exhaust manifold into the intake manifold, whereas euro 6 low-pressure egr draws clean, cooled exhaust gas downstream of the dpf back into the turbocharger compressor inlet.

items.k: glossary definition cerine / eolys fuel-borne catalyst additive (psa fap) cerine (eolys) is an iron/cerium organometallic fuel additive injected into the diesel tank on peugeot, citroën, ds, ford, volvo, and mazda hdi/bluehdi vehicles by a multiplexed additive pump to lower soot combustion temperature from 600°c to 450°c.

items.t: Intake Swirl Flaps & Tumble Generator Valves (P2015)
items.d: Intake swirl flaps (and petrol tumble generator valves) are electronically actuated butterflies inside individual intake manifold runners that pa…
items.k: glossary definition intake swirl flaps & tumble generator valves (p2015) intake swirl flaps (and petrol tumble generator valves) are electronically actuated butterflies inside individual intake manifold runners that partially close at low rpm to increase charge-air turbulence and combustion mixing.

items.d: The Torque-to-IQ map is the core physical translation table in torque-modeled diesel ECUs (Bosch EDC16, EDC17, MD1, Delphi DCM, Continental SID) …
items.k: glossary definition torque-to-injection-quantity (nm-to-iq) conversion map the torque-to-iq map is the core physical translation table in torque-modeled diesel ecus (bosch edc16, edc17, md1, delphi dcm, continental sid) converting requested internal crankshaft torque (nm) into fuel mass (mg/stroke) across engine rpm.

items.d: The Driver Wish map translates accelerator pedal position (0–100%) and engine speed (RPM) into a driver torque request (Nm or % load), often feat…
items.k: glossary definition driver wish (accelerator pedal-to-torque) map the driver wish map translates accelerator pedal position (0–100%) and engine speed (rpm) into a driver torque request (nm or % load), often featuring separate tables for eco, comfort, sport, reverse, and low-range 4wd.

items.t: Diesel Smoke Limiter (MAF vs MAP Lambda Limitation)
items.d: A diesel Smoke Limiter restricts maximum injected fuel quantity (mg/stroke) based on measured Mass Air Flow (MAF) or calculated Manifold Boost Pr…
items.k: glossary definition diesel smoke limiter (maf vs map lambda limitation) a diesel smoke limiter restricts maximum injected fuel quantity (mg/stroke) based on measured mass air flow (maf) or calculated manifold boost pressure (map) to maintain a clean stoichiometric excess-air ratio (lambda ≥ 1.15–1.22) and prevent black soot.

items.t: SOI (Start of Injection) Crankshaft Angle Maps
items.d: Start of Injection (SOI) maps specify the exact crankshaft angle in degrees Before Top Dead Center (°BTDC) at which the common-rail piezo or sole…
items.k: glossary definition soi (start of injection) crankshaft angle maps start of injection (soi) maps specify the exact crankshaft angle in degrees before top dead center (°btdc) at which the common-rail piezo or solenoid injector begins its main injection event as a function of rpm, iq, and coolant temperature.

items.t: Injector Duration ( energizing Time in µs) Calibration
items.d: Injector Duration tables define the exact microsecond (µs) energizing pulse width required to deliver a target fuel quantity (mg/stroke) at a giv…
items.k: glossary definition injector duration ( energizing time in µs) calibration injector duration tables define the exact microsecond (µs) energizing pulse width required to deliver a target fuel quantity (mg/stroke) at a given common-rail fuel pressure (bar), derived directly from bosch/delphi hydraulic bench flow curves.

items.t: VNT / VGT Variable Nozzle Turbocharger Duty & Setpoint

items.k: glossary definition vnt / vgt variable nozzle turbocharger duty & setpoint variable nozzle turbine (vnt / vgt) control uses vacuum or electronic pwm rea actuators to adjust turbine inlet vane angles—closing vanes at low rpm for fast spool and opening them at high exhaust flow to regulate boost and backpressure (emp).

items.d: Modern common-rail diesel systems (1,600 bar on EDC16 up to 2,500–2,700 bar on Bosch MD1 / Denso Gen3) atomize fuel via high-pressure pumps regul…
items.k: glossary definition common-rail fuel pressure (bar) & metering control modern common-rail diesel systems (1,600 bar on edc16 up to 2,500–2,700 bar on bosch md1 / denso gen3) atomize fuel via high-pressure pumps regulated by an inlet metering unit (imv/zme) and rail pressure control valve (pcv/drv).

items.t: DSG / S-Tronic Hydraulic Clutch Clamping Pressure

items.k: glossary definition dsg / s-tronic hydraulic clutch clamping pressure in wet dual-clutch transmissions (vag dq250, dq381, dq500, dl501), mechatronic solenoids modulate hydraulic oil pressure (bar) against k1 (odd gears) and k2 (even gears) multi-plate packs proportional to transmitted engine torque.

items.t: SAE J1939 SPN / FMI Heavy-Duty 24V Diagnostic Protocol

items.k: glossary definition sae j1939 spn / fmi heavy-duty 24v diagnostic protocol sae j1939 is the heavy-duty 250/500 kbps can communication standard used across 24v commercial trucks, buses, agricultural tractors, excavators, and marine diesel engines, encoding faults as suspect parameter numbers (spn) and failure mode identifiers (fmi).

items.k: glossary definition mercedes-benz cpc_ng (central powertrain controller) on modern mercedes-benz and amg euro 6d vehicles (w205 facelift, w213, w463a g63, sprinter vs30), the central powertrain controller (cpc_ng / ptcm) sits upstream of the bosch mg1/md1 engine ecu and enforces vehicle vmax speed limits, torque caps, and exhaust flap logic.

items.k: glossary definition overrun fuel-cut delay & crackle / burble ignition retard pops & bangs (overrun burble) delays deceleration fuel cut-off (dfco) for a controlled 0.8–2.0 second window above a safe minimum rpm while retarding ignition timing so small amounts of air-fuel mixture combust acoustically in a motorsport exhaust.

items.k: glossary definition hardcut / popcorn stationary & dynamic rev limiter a hardcut (popcorn) limiter replaces soft progressive diesel torque roll-off at redline with a sharp narrow-hysteresis fuel cut (e.g., 4,500 / 4,520 rpm), creating a crisp motorsport rally-style acoustic rev bounce.

items.t: Primary Wideband (LSU 4.9 / ADV) vs Rear Narrowband O2
items.d: Turbo-petrol and diesel ECUs use an upstream planar wideband Lambda sensor (Sensor 1) for real-time closed-loop Air-Fuel Ratio (AFR) fuel control…
items.k: glossary definition primary wideband (lsu 4.9 / adv) vs rear narrowband o2 turbo-petrol and diesel ecus use an upstream planar wideband lambda sensor (sensor 1) for real-time closed-loop air-fuel ratio (afr) fuel control, and a downstream narrowband sensor (sensor 2) strictly to monitor catalytic converter oxygen-storage efficiency (p0420 / p0430).

items.t: MAF (Mass Air Flow) vs MAP (Speed-Density) Airflow Calculation
items.d: Standard diesel ECUs measure inducted fresh air via a hot-film Mass Air Flow (MAF) sensor, whereas a MAF-to-MAP switch computes cylinder air mass…
items.k: glossary definition maf (mass air flow) vs map (speed-density) airflow calculation standard diesel ecus measure inducted fresh air via a hot-film mass air flow (maf) sensor, whereas a maf-to-map switch computes cylinder air mass mathematically from manifold absolute pressure, intake air temperature, engine displacement, and volumetric efficiency.

items.k: glossary definition tricore pflash (program/maps) vs dflash (emulated eeprom) infineon tricore microcontrollers divide internal non-volatile memory into program flash (pflash — storing operating code and calibration maps) and data flash (dflash — emulating eeprom to store immobilizer keys, injector ima codes, mileage, and adblue counters).

items.k: glossary definition sae j2534 passthru & can-fd diagnostic interfaces sae j2534-1/2 is a universal hardware communication api (supported by scanmatik 2 pro, tactrix openport, autotuner, kess3, and oem vci interfaces) enabling pc flashing suites like pcmflash and bitbox to communicate over can, k-line, doip, and high-speed can-fd.

items.k: glossary definition marine wot (wide-open throttle) propeller load & bsfc tuning unlike road vehicles that coast in top gear, marine inboard, sterndrive, outboard, and pwc engines operate under continuous cubic hull resistance, making continuous egt control, intercooler water flow, and mid-rpm brake specific fuel consumption (bsfc in g/kwh) critical.

items.t: Auto Start-Stop Temperature / Voltage Hysteresis Deactivation
items.d: Rather than cutting CAN wires to the Intelligent Battery Sensor (IBS), ECU-level Start-Stop deactivation adjusts ambient-temperature or minimum-s…
items.k: glossary definition auto start-stop temperature / voltage hysteresis deactivation rather than cutting can wires to the intelligent battery sensor (ibs), ecu-level start-stop deactivation adjusts ambient-temperature or minimum-speed enable thresholds inside the engine controller so automatic engine shutdown never triggers.
